takes.title: Walk Out and Turn Back
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks with low arm swings, turns through profile, and continues stepping through another heading change. The final frame is mid-stride facing away.

takes.title: Give Chest-Height Signals and Lift Both Hands
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with hands gathered at the chest, alternates short outward gestures with higher hand lifts, and draws the arms back in to finish.

takes.title: Act Out a Teapot Rhyme with One Hand on the Hip
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts hands-on-hips, dips slightly, and repeatedly lifts one forearm while the other hand rests at the waist. They finish hands-on-hips.

takes.title: Gesture Close to the Chest and Finish with One Hand High
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates close two-handed gestures with small outward reaches, adds a forward lean, and ends upright with one hand raised.

takes.title: Act Out a Rhyme with Repeated Face-Level Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates lifting a hand near the face with opening both arms and bending forward. The sequence ends upright with the hands together.

takes.title: Give Compact Signals with a High Two-Hand Accent
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with elbows bent, brings an arm across the chest, then lifts both hands near the head before returning to a narrow upright stance.

takes.title: Act Out a Teapot Rhyme with an Outstretched Arm
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens from hands on hips into a lateral arm extension, then alternates a raised forearm and weight shifts. They finish with both hands at the hips.

takes.title: Raise the Hands Near the Head and Gesture Outward
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with hands out, lifts both hands near the head, then alternates side reaches and smaller chest-level gestures. They end with hands together.

takes.title: Act Out a Rhyme with Hand-to-Face Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with the forearms across the torso, repeatedly shifts between face-level and chest-level gestures, and finishes with the hands gathered.

takes.title: Make Broad Hand Gestures with Side Leans
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both hands near the head, dips and shifts side to side, then ends leaning forward with one hand extended.

takes.title: Repeat Open-Hand Gestures with Small Knee Bends
takes.actionDescription: From arms near the sides, the performer cycles between forward and lateral hand extensions and lightly bends the knees. One open hand remains out at the end.

takes.title: Alternate Close Gestures and Wide Arm Openings
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, repeatedly gathers the hands near the chest, then spreads the arms and adds shallow dips. They return upright with arms lowered.

takes.title: Mime a Prairie Dog with Small Crouches
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both hands near the face and alternates small crouches with upright resets. The last pose holds a forward bend with hands close together.

takes.title: Mime a Whale with Forward Arm Sweeps
takes.actionDescription: The performer pushes both forearms forward from bent knees, then draws them in and shifts weight. The take ends with the hands gathered at the torso.

takes.title: Mime a Bear with High Curved Arm Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly raises bent arms around the head and opens the elbows outward. They lower the elbows partway while remaining upright.

takes.title: Mime a Dog with Hands Lifted near the Face
takes.actionDescription: From standing, the performer repeatedly draws both hands upward while leaning and flexing the knees. The take ends with one hand near the face.

takes.title: Mime a Cat with Compact Hand Lifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps the elbows close, repeatedly lifts the hands toward the face, and adds small forward bends. The final pose stays compact with the hands high.

takes.title: Mime a Fish with Small Hand Sweeps
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings the hands close to the face, opens or overlaps the forearms, and alternates shallow knee bends with standing. They finish hands-up.

takes.title: Mime an Elephant with Repeated Forward Bends
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, folds forward repeatedly with one hand near the head and the other arm reaching lower, and stands upright to finish.

takes.title: Mime a Mouse with Small Crouches and Face-Level Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands near the face, leans into short crouches, and repeatedly straightens. They finish upright with one hand near the hip.

takes.title: Mime a Chicken with Repeated Elbow Lifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates low knee bends with lifting both elbows away from the chest. The final pose holds both elbows out.

takes.title: Mime a Dinosaur with High and Forward Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens from standing into an overhead arm lift, then makes forward reaches with bent knees. They return upright with the hands close to the hips.

takes.title: Mime a Snake with Subtle Weight Shifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer stays mostly upright with arms low and makes small shifts and bends of the torso. The take ends facing slightly to one side.

takes.title: Mime a Monkey with Wide Elbows and Forward Bends
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts the elbows, brings the hands toward the head, and alternates forward bends and arm openings. They finish upright with arms lowered.
